title: Astrid & William
subtitle: Full Wedding Stationary Suite Design
desc:
Imagined for Astrid and Will’s wedding, this stationery suite set out to capture the effortless romance of an Italian summer: elegant enough to feel like an occasion, relaxed enough to feel like a lakeside celebration.

Drawing inspiration from the timeless romance of Lake Como and sun-drenched Tuscan estates, I designed a suite that channels old-world European opulence while staying light and easy-going. Developed as a spec project, it gave me room to explore every detail, from the first monogram to the final coaster.

The palette is pulled from the natural gardens and stone terraces of a Tuscan villa: soft dusty blue, earthy terracotta, and pops of fresh lemon yellow. The suite includes custom monograms, invitation cards, RSVP cards, table place cards, table numbers, food and drink menus, wine labels, food packaging, coasters and hand fans, all designed to set the tone before the first guest arrives.
details:

TOOLS: Illustrator, Photoshop
